verdict.rationale: dLocal documents webhook notifications sent to a merchant-specified URL for every payment status change, with signature verification. An agent could use these, plus API charges against a saved card_id or enrollment ID, to watch for failed payments and re-charge manually. There is no documented retry scheduling or dunning outreach, so the agent would have to build those itself. Missing for 10: native smart retry/retry scheduling, dunning email/outreach workflows, explicit failed-payment query/filter API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: Notifications will be sent to the notification URL specified by the merchant for every change in payment status.
By verifying this signature, you'll confirm that the notification was not modified during transmission.
For recurring payments, first save the card, and then use the `card_id` to charge the card.
The dLocal MCP server acts as a bridge between your AI agent and dLocal's systems.
